Class Sentence

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.nlg.Sentence
public class Sentence extends Object
A structure allowing one Subject-Verb-Object element in a sentence to "know" about the others.

    • doPassiveVoice

      private void doPassiveVoice()
      If we haven't managed to create a subject, try creating one with Patient. The result will be "experiences" + the process verb in a noun form. This can be seen as a precursor of correct passive voice.
